# package mqtt

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/transport/mqtt"
```

Package mqtt is the MQTT transport of OPC UA PubSub (Part 14 §7.3.4 in 1.05.06, §7.3.5 in earlier 1.05 editions): NetworkMessages (UADP or JSON) as MQTT 3.1.1 or MQTT 5.0 messages on a broker.

Importing the package registers the "mqtt" and "mqtts" schemes with [transport.Register](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/transport#Register).

The URL is mqtt://host\[:1883] or mqtts://host\[:8883]. Send publishes to PublishOptions.Topic (the QueueName of the writer group, or the MetaDataQueueName of a writer) with its QoS (0, 1 or 2: at most, at least and exactly once, §7.3.4.5) and Retain flag; Subscribe subscribes a topic filter, MQTT wildcards allowed. The connection reconnects by itself with exponential backoff, subscribes again and retransmits unacknowledged QoS 1 and 2 messages; QoS 0 messages sent while it is reconnecting fail with ErrNotConnected.

#### MQTT version {#hdr-MQTT_version}

The version is Config.MQTTVersion or else the connection property MqttVersion (§7.3.4.4, Table 201): "3.1.1", "5.0" or "BestAvailable" (5.0 if the broker accepts it, else 3.1.1). Part 14 makes BestAvailable the default; go-opcua keeps 3.1.1 as the default, the version every PubSub peer speaks (open62541 1.5 has no 5.0).

With MQTT 5.0 every message carries the Content Type of its encoding, "application/opcua+uadp" or "application/json" (§7.3.4.9.1, §7.3.4.9.2; for metadata too: the body is a UADP discovery response or a JSON ua-metadata message), and the User Property UAMessageType ("ua-data", "ua-metadata", §7.3.4.8 Table 207). Received messages expose their Content Type and User Properties on [transport.Message](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/transport#Message). The standard connection properties of Table 202 set the CONNECT: "connection-ClientID", "connection-Receive Maximum", "connection-Maximum Packet Size" (the lower of it and the message size limit), "connection-Session Expiry Interval" (a value above 0 keeps the session on the broker for that many seconds), "connection-Request Response Information" and "connection-Request Problem Information"; "connection-Topic Alias Maximum" is ignored, the transport never accepts topic aliases. Every other connection property that is not one of go-opcua's ("client-id", "username", "password", "keep-alive") or MqttTopicPrefix becomes a User Property of the CONNECT. Over 3.1.1 these settings are silently discarded, as Part 14 asks.

open62541 1.5 connects with MQTT 3.1.1, an empty client identifier and a clean session, publishes and subscribes at QoS 0 without retain, and uses a keep-alive of 400 s; this transport talks to the same brokers.

Besides the Config fields the connection properties "client-id", "username", "password" and "keep-alive" (seconds) are honoured where the corresponding Config field is empty.

## Constants

```go
const (
	Version311           = "3.1.1"
	Version5             = "5.0"
	VersionBestAvailable = "BestAvailable"
)
```

Values of the MqttVersion connection property (Part 14 §7.3.4.4).

```go
const (
	PropMqttVersion                = "MqttVersion"
	PropMqttTopicPrefix            = "MqttTopicPrefix"
	PropClientID                   = "connection-ClientID"
	PropReceiveMaximum             = "connection-Receive Maximum"
	PropMaximumPacketSize          = "connection-Maximum Packet Size"
	PropSessionExpiryInterval      = "connection-Session Expiry Interval"
	PropTopicAliasMaximum          = "connection-Topic Alias Maximum"
	PropRequestResponseInformation = "connection-Request Response Information"
	PropRequestProblemInformation  = "connection-Request Problem Information"
)
```

Names of the connection properties of Part 14 §7.3.4.4 (Tables 201 and 202). The namespace index of the keys is 0.

```go
const (
	CompressionNone = "none"
	CompressionGzip = "gzip"
)
```

Values of PropJSONCompression.

```go
const DefaultMaxMessageSize = 1 << 20
```

DefaultMaxMessageSize is the default limit of a NetworkMessage.

```go
const PropJSONCompression = "JsonCompression"
```

PropJSONCompression is the connection property of go-opcua that compresses the JSON NetworkMessages a connection sends: CompressionGzip sends them gzip compressed (RFC 1952) with the Content Type application/json+gzip of Part 14 §7.3.4.9.1, CompressionNone (the default) uncompressed. Part 14 defines the compressed content type for MQTT 5.0 only: a connection that runs MQTT 3.1.1 cannot say that a message is compressed and sends it uncompressed.

## Variables

```go
var ErrNotConnected = imqtt.ErrNotConnected
```

ErrNotConnected is returned by a QoS 0 Send while the connection is re-established.

## Functions

### func CheckProperties

```go
func CheckProperties(props map[string]string) error
```

CheckProperties checks the values of the MQTT connection properties of Part 14 §7.3.4.4: the version, and numbers and Booleans where Table 202 asks for them.

### func ContentTypeOf

```go
func ContentTypeOf(profileURI string) string
```

ContentTypeOf returns the Content Type of the NetworkMessages of a transport profile, "" if the profile has none.

### func ParseVersion

```go
func ParseVersion(s string) (byte, error)
```

ParseVersion maps a value of the MqttVersion connection property to the protocol version of the client ("": 3.1.1).

## Types

### type Conn

```go
type Conn struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Conn is an MQTT PubSub connection.

#### func Open

```go
func Open(ctx context.Context, cfg transport.Config) (*Conn, error)
```

Open connects to the broker of cfg.URL. Failed attempts are retried with backoff until ctx ends, except refusals a retry cannot fix (bad credentials, ...), so ctx should carry a deadline.

#### func (Conn) Close

```go
func (c *Conn) Close() error
```

Close disconnects from the broker.

#### func (Conn) Connected

```go
func (c *Conn) Connected() bool
```

Connected reports whether the connection to the broker is up right now.

#### func (Conn) MaxMessageSize

```go
func (c *Conn) MaxMessageSize() int
```

MaxMessageSize is the largest payload Send accepts.

#### func (Conn) Send

```go
func (c *Conn) Send(ctx context.Context, payload []byte, opts transport.PublishOptions) error
```

Send publishes payload to opts.Topic. QoS 1 waits for the broker's acknowledgement and QoS 2 for the end of the exactly once exchange (and, while reconnecting, for the connection).

#### func (Conn) Subscribe

```go
func (c *Conn) Subscribe(ctx context.Context, topic string, qos byte, h transport.Handler) (func() error, error)
```

Subscribe subscribes h to a topic filter. The returned function unsubscribes.

#### func (Conn) Version

```go
func (c *Conn) Version() string
```

Version returns the MQTT version of the connection: Version311 or Version5.
